intro: Georgia is famous for polyphonic singing, ancient wine and hearty food.

chapters.title: Singing and dance
text: Georgian polyphonic singing, with three-part harmonies, is on UNESCO's heritage list. National dances are fast and acrobatic.

chapters.title: Food
text: Khachapuri (cheese bread), khinkali (dumplings), churchkhela (nut sweets) and qvevri wine are classics.

keyTerms.meaning: Several melodies sung at the same time.
